messages:
maria: Quick async check-in — API gateway / routing / auth / rate limits. What I did: drafted per-route fallback policy for overload. Blockers: need review on policy semantics. Today: rebase + monitor staging canary

jon: Did: merged route-weighting config PR, and started adding the per-key burst limiter. Blocked: integration tests failing around jwt header parsing (looks like malformed kid).

alex: Fixed the jwt parsing test in #421 (missing header edge-case). Rebased is fine now, ping me if CI flakes.

maria: Rebased and kicked CI for the policy PR (438). Leaving it to @alex or @jon for a quick review.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI passed for gw-config and policy PRs, starting canary roll to staging (subset=5%).

sasha: Noticed a 3x 429 spike on /v1/generate at ~14:02 UTC on staging. Added temporary debug logs. Looks like a single client sending 200 reqs in quick succession.

maria: Saw the same. I think we need per-key burst caps. Proposed config snippet:```routes:
  /v1/generate:
    rate_limit:
      per_key: 10r/s
      burst: 50
      strategy: token_bucket```Can someone sanity-check?

jon: That config looks reasonable. Question on semantics: does burst=50 allow an initial high-volume warmup or does it refill only at per_key rate? Make sure token bucket refill behavior is documented.

alex: token_bucket refill is per_key/second with burst reservoir. Works for short spikes. Also: are we okay with dropping vs queuing? I prefer dropping with 429 for abusive bursts.

sasha: Agreed drop -> 429. Also added a short middleware to tag requests exceeding burst with header X-Rate-Attribution for quick tracing. Rolling that now.

maria: Blocker for me: need someone to review fallback ordering in PR 438 — it currently tries: primary -> model-lite -> global-fallback. Want to confirm ordering is correct for latency-sensitive routes. @alex @jon can you take a look?

alex: Reviewing now. Small nit: swap model-lite and global-fallback for /v1/embeddings routes. Will push patch and re-run tests.

jon: FYI I'm scheduling the JWT signing key rotation this Tue 10:00 UTC with infra-kms. Plan: serve old key for 24h fallback. Will post to #announcements and update auth middleware to accept missing kid header for a short window.

sasha: Thanks. I pushed a tiny change to accept absent kid header and try discovery endpoint as fallback. Rolling it to staging.

maria: Thanks both. Also adding an alert candidate: sudden_tokens_per_min_per_key > 10000 -> paging. Thoughts?

alex: Good metric. Maybe start with a non-paging alert at 10k and paging at 50k. We can tune after one week.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: gateway/rlimit v1.2 rolled to staging — all instances healthy.

maria: Plan for today: finish PR review, monitor staging for 2h post-roll, submit runbook update for burst handling, and prepare rotation announcement. If anyone can review PR 438 in next 30m that'd be great. :thumbsup:

jon: I'll take it now.

alex: on it, will finish in ~20m.

sasha: Monitoring logs, will flag any regressions.

maria: Thanks team — closing this thread unless new blockers pop up.
